readme.markdown:
# ai-rate-limit-tracker-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-rate-limit-tracker. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/ai-rate-limit-tracker

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_limits
toolsPreview.description: Get published rate limit specs (RPM, TPM, RPD, context window) for an AI provider and optional model.

toolsPreview.name: list_providers
toolsPreview.description: List all AI providers supported by the tracker with their models and default limits.

toolsPreview.name: track_usage
toolsPreview.description: Record an AI API call and get real-time usage counters plus warnings if approaching limits.

toolsPreview.name: get_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Forecast when rate limits will be exhausted and get scheduling recommendations.
